chamada.titulo: Legal counsel for those who build and run businesses in the digital environment.
chamada.texto: From structuring contracts and partnerships to protecting brands, content and rights, we support the legal challenges of those who do business on the internet.

assuntos.faz: Legal structuring of digital businesses and operations. Preventive and advisory counsel.
Drafting and review of contracts. Terms of use and privacy policies. Recovery of suspended or restricted marketplace accounts.
Compliance with the LGPD (Brazil’s General Data Protection Law). Data protection policies and documents.
Trademark registration with the INPI (Brazil’s patent and trademark office). Protection of copyright and content.
Advertising, sponsorship and co-production contracts. Legal counsel for brands, agencies and creators.
Legal guidance on the use of artificial intelligence. Internal policies and digital governance.
Recovery of suspended or restricted accounts. Content removal and protection of rights.
Legal guidance and obtaining court authorization.

corpo: Digital law covers the legal relationships established in the technological environment and their effects on the activities of companies, professionals and individuals.

For businesses, it covers the structuring of digital operations, contracts, data protection, intellectual property, advertising and the use of new technologies. For professionals and individuals, it also includes the protection of rights related to image, content and presence on digital platforms.
Our work combines preventive and advisory counsel with out-of-court and court measures, according to the needs of each situation.
Legal support for companies that operate online, including structuring operations, reviewing commercial practices, contracts, partnerships and risk prevention.
Drafting and review of terms of use, contracts and policies applicable to digital operations, taking into account how the business works and consumer and data protection law.
Analysis of personal data processing operations, identification of the applicable legal bases and preparation of policies and procedures for LGPD compliance.
Trademark registration, copyright protection and contractual definition of the ownership and use of content, materials and creations.
Legal structuring of campaigns and commercial relationships between brands, agencies and content creators, including contracts, image rights, deliverables and responsibilities.
Guidance on legal risks related to the use of artificial intelligence, personal data and intellectual property, as well as the preparation of internal policies and guidelines.
Action in situations involving blocked accounts, fake profiles and misuse of image and content, including preservation of evidence, takedown requests and appropriate court measures.
Guidance on the legal requirements for minors to take part in advertising campaigns and content productions, including procedures for obtaining court authorization.

perguntas.pergunta: Why does a company that operates online need legal counsel?
perguntas.resposta: Digital businesses also need well-structured contracts, data protection, compliant commercial relationships and protection of their intellectual property. Legal counsel helps prevent problems and structure the business to grow more securely.

perguntas.pergunta: Do I need to register the trademark of my digital business?
perguntas.resposta: Registration with the INPI is the main way to legally protect a trademark in Brazil. It gives the owner the exclusive right to use it in the relevant field of activity, preventing third parties from using identical or similar signs in certain circumstances.

perguntas.pergunta: What should I do if my Instagram or other social media account is suspended?
perguntas.resposta: The first step is to identify the reason for the suspension and gather documents and records showing ownership of the account and any irregularity in the measure. Depending on the case, recovery can be sought through administrative or court channels.

perguntas.pergunta: Do digital influencers need contracts with brands?
perguntas.resposta: Yes. The contract sets out each party’s obligations, deliverables, compensation, deadlines, image rights, use of the content and responsibilities. This reduces ambiguity and prevents conflicts during and after the partnership.

perguntas.pergunta: Can I use images, videos or music found online in my content?
perguntas.resposta: Not necessarily. The fact that content is available online does not mean it is free to use. Images, videos, music and texts may be protected by copyright, so it is necessary to observe the terms of use or obtain permission.

perguntas.pergunta: Does my digital business need to comply with the LGPD?
perguntas.resposta: Yes, if it carries out personal data processing operations, such as collecting information from customers, leads or users. The LGPD sets rules for this processing, and the business must adopt measures compatible with its activities and responsibilities.

perguntas.pergunta: Do I need terms of use and a privacy policy on my website or platform?
perguntas.resposta: These documents are important to set the rules for using the service and to inform how personal data is collected, used and stored. Whether they are needed and what they contain should take into account the characteristics of the digital operation.

perguntas.pergunta: Can I use artificial intelligence in my company without legal risks?
perguntas.resposta: Using artificial intelligence tools requires attention to issues such as personal data protection, copyright, confidentiality and liability for the information produced. Adopting internal guidelines helps set limits and reduce risks.

perguntas.pergunta: Is it possible to remove online content that misuses my image or my brand?
perguntas.resposta: Yes. Depending on the circumstances, it is possible to request removal of the content directly from the platform and, when necessary, seek court measures. The strategy depends on the nature of the violation and the evidence available.

perguntas.pergunta: Do I need court authorization to show images of children and adolescents in advertising campaigns?
perguntas.resposta: The participation of children and adolescents in advertising may require court authorization, depending on the characteristics of the activity and the applicable legal requirements. It is important to assess the project in advance to identify the requirements and avoid irregularities.
